headline.caveat: announced Dec 2025 alongside a three-year Sora IP license; withdrawn Mar 24, 2026

nature_md: December 2025: Disney agreed to invest $1B in OpenAI as part of a comprehensive licensing arrangement giving Sora and other OpenAI generative products access to 200+ masked, animated, and creature characters from Disney, Marvel, Pixar, and Star Wars under a three-year license — the first big-media equity-plus-IP pact with a frontier lab. On **Mar 24, 2026** OpenAI shut down the Sora app (reported losses ~$1M/day), informing Disney less than an hour before the public announcement; Disney withdrew the investment the same day. **$0 was ever delivered.** The dataset's cautionary exemplar: a billion-dollar 'deal' that appeared in every AI-investment tally for a quarter and produced no money flow at all — commitment-vs-realized discipline in one edge.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Nothing was ever booked — the commitment died before funding; no impairment, no investment, no disclosure obligation beyond news coverage. The reputational whiplash (embracing then fleeing generative AI) is unaccounted anywhere.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: OpenAI received no proceeds and lost the IP license that was Sora's content moat; the app shutdown that triggered the withdrawal also removed the product the license existed to feed.

events.title: Disney announces $1B OpenAI investment + 3-year Sora IP license (200+ characters)
OpenAI shuts down Sora app; Disney withdraws the $1B investment ($0 delivered)
events.why_it_matters: Demonstrates how fast announced AI commitments can evaporate — and that headline tallies of 'AI investment' include money that never moves.
